notes: Version 2.1 corrects two motivation passages. Version 2.0 derived the exclusion of emergent gauge structure under an injective projection from trivial holonomy; trivial holonomy does not exclude gauge transformations. Both passages now ground the exclusion on injectivity itself: an injective projection admits no non-trivial re-identification of its fibres and, in the admissible principal-bundle setting, has a trivial structure group. PDF title and author metadata are set. No result of the paper changes.
